title: Name tag
description:
Print a name tag for a conference. Use your own name if you like while experimenting, but to pass the check print this one exactly:

```
+----------------+
| HELLO          |
| my name is     |
| Ada            |
+----------------+
```

Each line is 18 characters wide. Count the spaces carefully, or copy the lines from above into your strings.
hints: One `std::cout` statement per line of the tag keeps it readable. Everything between the quotes is printed exactly as written, spaces included.
stretch: Run it with your own name. What do you have to change to keep the right edge straight?
